Configuration.ConcurrencyControlNote: No ETag / If-Match / version field observed on any sampled top-level resource schema (Contact, Account, Sequence). Conflict handling must be snapshot-3-way only -- do not recommend MostRecent conflict resolution.
Configuration.DeleteSemanticsNote: DELETE and bulk-delete endpoints are documented as removal. No universal soft-delete/archive boolean or status field was found across sampled schemas.
Configuration.DefaultSyncDirectionNote: Read-only by default for every object, per the read-first bidirectional-opt-in policy. Configuration.DefaultConflictResolutionNote: ConcurrencyControl=none rules out MostRecent (no reliable timestamp/version to arbitrate on) and DestWins/SourceWins are unsafe defaults against a live sales-engagement system with side-effecting writes (enrollment/send). Manual is the only policy consistent with the evidence if bidirectional is ever enabled for a specific object after sandbox validation.
